verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own site says users can install it in place of Windows or 'run Ubuntu alongside it' [ubuntu-docs-3, ubuntu-docs-22]. The help portal provides step-by-step installation tutorials and bootable USB guidance [ubuntu-docs-9, ubuntu-docs-10], which supports an install-alongside workflow. However, the evidence is marketing-level and does not detail the dual-boot process itself. Missing for 10: dedicated dual-boot docs (partitioning, bootloader/GRUB OS selection, Secure Boot/BitLocker caveats), non-Windows coexistence (e.g. macOS or other Linux), independent or hands-on corroboration that dual-boot installs work smoothly.
